title: Rep. Ron Tusler criticizes governor's actions and court ruling
text:
Ron Tusler, Wisconsin State Representative of 3rd District | Facebook
Ron Tusler, Wisconsin State Representative of 3rd District | Facebook
Rep. Ron Tusler has recently voiced his concerns on social media regarding decisions made by Governor Tony Evers and the Wisconsin Supreme Court. Through a series of tweets, Tusler shared his stance on various political matters affecting the state.
On July 7, 2025, Rep. Ron Tusler posted about a press release he co-authored with Sen. André Jacque concerning Governor Evers' veto of the Brillion Dredging Project at an early morning hour. He stated: "My press release with Sen. André Jacque on Governor Evers' 1:30 AM veto of the Brillion Dredging Project."
The following day, July 8, 2025, Tusler criticized a decision by the Wisconsin Supreme Court in another tweet. He expressed concern over what he perceives as unchecked power given to Governor Evers’ administration: "The liberal WI Supreme Court just gave Gov. Evers’ admin a blank check to essentially write 'laws' with no legislative oversight." He emphasized that Wisconsin is heavily regulated and advocated for a "Red Tape Reset" to curb bureaucratic overreach.
On July 9, 2025, Rep. Tusler reiterated his commitment to advocating for the Brillion Dredging Project despite opposition from Madison and Governor Evers. He tweeted: "I will not let Madison & Governor Evers forget about Brillion." Tusler highlighted the efforts of residents living along the Manitowoc River and pledged to continue urging the Department of Natural Resources (DNR) to proceed with the project.
### Additional information for Step 3:
The Brillion Dredging Project involves environmental management and infrastructure development efforts aimed at improving waterway conditions in Brillion, Wisconsin.
